SELECT br.record_id, br.user_id, u.username, u.name AS user_name, br.book_id, b.title AS book_title, b.author AS book_author, b.isbn AS book_isbn, br.borrow_date, br.due_date, br.return_date, br.renew_count, br.status, br.overdue_days, br.overdue_fee, br.book_status, br.remark, br.create_time, br.update_time FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN user u ON br.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.book_id
AND br.status IN ('借阅中', '已逾期') AND br.due_date < NOW()
AND br.user_id = #{query.userId}
AND (br.book_id = #{query.bookIdOrIsbn} OR b.isbn = #{query.bookIdOrIsbn})
AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.bookTitle}, '%')
ORDER BY br.due_date ASC
